mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% over three months signals weakening consumer demand and corporate earnings pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 6.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over two consecutive quarters signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings and depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS declines for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of two-quarter RSAFS declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month acceleration in industrial production above 2% signals improved manufacturing activity and earnings momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO growth exceeds 2% for three months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of INDPRO > 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in CPIAUCSL above 2% and FEDFUNDS above 4.5% over two months signals a tightening monetary policy stance, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 2% AND FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for two months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of CPIAUCSL > 2% and FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in UNRATE above 6.5% and PAYEMS below 140,000 for three months signals severe labor market weakness and earnings contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 6.5% AND PAYEMS < 140,000 for three months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of UNRATE > 6.5% and PAYEMS < 140,000 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in HOUST above 1,600 for four consecutive months signals robust housing demand and consumer confidence, which boosts discretionary spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of HOUST > 1,600 for four months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month decline in INDPRO below 0% signals manufacturing contraction and earnings downgrades, which depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of INDPRO < 0% for six months (t-test p > 0.05).
